name: public_ds2_v9_force_labels_fixed_cross_user_screen
source_identity: v9 publisher force-label MAT joined through byte-identical MAV and gesture MAT files to the already exact v8 raw-to-window join
eligibility: verified TDMS subject folder, uniform gesture code, four active gesture codes 0-3; exclude 30 unknown-subject raw trials, one mixed-gesture trial, and code 4 Rest
windowing: three nonoverlapping 375-sample raw windows per 10-second trial, starts 3000/6000/9000 at 1500 Hz; one mean-probability vote per trial
classifier: StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=2000, random_state=20260928); all family state and scaler fit on train subjects only

training_modes.unseen_high: train source users on force codes 0/1 only; score code 2 separately in held-out users; no target or high-force calibration
training_modes.product_all: train source users on all 0/1/2 force codes; score each force in held-out users

selection: No arm or hyperparameter selection before reporting all three fixed arms. Validation and final subjects were used in earlier gesture-only work, so both phases are descriptive rather than pristine blind tests.
boundaries: subjective instructed force categories, not measured mechanical force
new reconstructed F1, not historical X1-H equivalence
